summary.name: darktable
summary.one_liner: darktable is an open source photography workflow application that combines a digital lighttable (asset management) and darkroom (raw photo editing).
use_cases: Organizing and managing a photo library
Speeding up editing with GPU acceleration
summary.what_it_does: Provides a lighttable for browsing and managing digital assets and a darkroom for editing images. Editing is non-destructive across its whole pipeline, so original files are never modified. Uses stack-based, scene-referred editing for advanced raw processing. Includes professional color management intended to keep fidelity through to print. Can use the GPU to accelerate processing. The page also points to a user FAQ, feature list, installation instructions, mailing list, forum, and source code.
notable: Non-destructive editing; original image is never modified
Combined digital asset management and raw processing
caveats: Platform support is not named on the page text; installation details are linked but not included
